activity.notes: After proclamation of the Federal People's Republic of Yugoslavia on 29 November 1945, Tito continued as head of government. ATLAS ends this Prime Minister Activity on 14 January 1953 when the new constitutional arrangement created the presidency and Tito became President of the Republic; his continuing head-of-government functions after that date are not duplicated because the presidency is the primary sovereign Activity shown for the same period.

sources.title: Dignitaries — Archives of Yugoslavia
sources.citation_text: The Archives of Yugoslavia records Tito's long government leadership beginning in March 1945.

sources.title: Constituent Acts of Yugoslavia — Archives of Yugoslavia
sources.citation_text: The Archives records the 1945 establishment of the FPRY and the constitutional reorganization of the Yugoslav state.
